tasks.name: Backend Development
tasks.description: Parent/summary row with its own children — start/end/%/resources here are rolled up automatically and shouldn't be directly editable.

tasks.name: API Endpoints
tasks.description: Depends on the entire Phase 1 parent task ('ph1'), not a specific leaf inside it — exercises a leaf-depends-on-a-parent-in-another-branch dependency. Off-track and behind schedule: should render as overdue (red-bordered bar, red row accent) since it's <100% complete with an end date in the past.

tasks.name: Database Schema
tasks.description: Multi-resource task (2 people) chained off ph2-be-api — also behind schedule (overdue). Exercises a positive dependency lag: the DBA isn't available the moment the API work finishes, so this doesn't start until 2 working days after ph2-be-api ends, not the very next working day. Should show a '+2d' badge on this task's Deps chip/popover, and the Gantt/tooltip gap between the two should visibly reflect the wait.

tasks.name: Frontend Development
tasks.description: Sibling parent branch to ph2-be — its child depends on a task in the ph2-be branch, exercising a cross-branch (sibling-subtree) dependency rather than same-branch or ancestor.

tasks.name: UI Components
tasks.description: Resources use lowercase 'carol' — since 'Carol' (capitalized) already appears earlier in this file on ph2-be-db, this should canonicalize to the same person, same capitalization, in every resource list/filter/Dashboard person-card. No RAG status set (should show the neutral/unset dot, not a color). Exercises a negative dependency lag (lead time): UI work can start against the mocked API shape before ph2-be-api is fully finished, so this is allowed to start 1 working day before ph2-be-api's own end date — the overlapping-tasks case, not just 'waits longer'. Should show a '-1d' badge.

tasks.description: Deliberately unassigned (empty resources) — should appear in the Dashboard's virtual 'Unassigned' person card.

tasks.name: Data Migration Script
tasks.description: Manual-end task (manualEnd: true) — 'end' is the user-set field of record and 'duration' is derived from the start/end range on load, rather than the usual duration-drives-end direction. Also overdue: end date is in the past and it's not 100% complete.
